summary: Executed backend + mobile-web UI validation for world v3 expansion, railgate behavior, GPS landmarks/bridges, migration, and regression suite. Full backend suite: 36 passed, 1 failed (railway train visibility window endpoint logic). UI rail crossing and GPS flows are largely working with noted integration/telemetry gaps.

critical.issue: Train visibility window is implemented as phase >=12 and <35, but requested/spec text requires visible through phase 35 (12..35). Off-by-one mismatch reproduced in pytest.

integration_issues.flow: Closed railgate telemetry during rider push
integration_issues.issue: Rider is physically blocked near y~2948/2949 while gate is closed, but railway telemetry 'blocked' remained false in sampled frames; signal may be too transient or not reliably exposed for UI assertions.

Observed collision damage toast while waiting at closed gate fixture area due nearby traffic interactions; barrier-specific no-damage guarantee is hard to isolate from traffic collisions in current UI flow.

action_items: Fix railway phase boundary so train visibility includes phase 35 per requirement (or align requirement text if current behavior is intentional).
Make rail blocked telemetry persist long enough (or latched) for reliable UI validation when user is held at gate barrier.
Add deterministic anti-collision buffer for player at closed gate fixture zone if no-damage-near-barrier behavior is expected under traffic pressure.
(Optional) add top-level stable load testID if you want a single root selector for quick health checks.
critical_code_review_comments: order_routes.py stores new orders with world_version=2 (legacy marker) while player/world is v3; verify this is intentional and does not affect analytics/compat checks.
Traffic generation code review confirms 74 vehicles and bike majority (40 bikes / 34 cars), matching requested ratio direction.
Frontend/API env usage is consistent with current codebase using EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL.
seed_data_creation: Created isolated anonymous test sessions via POST /api/sessions; temporary profile fixture updates were applied only to isolated test sessions (position/at_garage/world_version/progression checks), then cleaned up where applicable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rail UI proof is captured near Habra central gate with fixture position x=2840,y=2880 and at_garage=false after reload. Verify blocked telemetry behavior while holding ride-down during closed phase. Validate train-visible boundary at exactly phase 35 after backend fix.
rca_of_issue: Primary backend failure is an off-by-one boundary in railway_state: train_visible uses phase < train_until where train_until=35. Requirement states visible through phase 35, but implementation drops visibility at phase 35. UI telemetry mismatch likely due frame-level railBlocked reset each tick and non-latched exposure after release; sampled after-hold state often returns blocked:false.
